{{Quote|It's because we work and we work and we don't get greensick. No other mining village on Lanteeb can claim that. They don't know our secret. Not Chukba, not Endvo, not Deebin, not even Trahn.|[[Jaklin]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
'''Chukba''' was a [[Damotite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] village situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. The inhabitants of Chukba were at a disadvantage to those of the rival mining village [[Torbel]], because they did not have knowledge of how to avoid suffering from the effects of Damotite [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].
